step-1.text: Lay one side panel flat, holes facing up. Screw in two cam pins and tap in two wood dowels.

count-1.text: This step uses 1 side panel, 2 cam pins and 2 wood dowels.

step-2.text: Push the bottom panel onto the low pins and dowels. Drop two cam locks into the round holes, arrows facing the pins, and turn them clockwise until they grab.

count-2.text: This step uses 1 bottom panel and 2 cam locks.

step-3.text: Pins and dowels go into the ends of the panels on this side too. With a helper, lower the second side onto all of them at once, then lock the last two cam locks.

count-3.text: This step uses 1 side panel, 2 cam pins, 2 wood dowels and 2 cam locks.

step-4.text: Tap four dowels into the top edges of the sides. Set the top panel on, good side up, then lock it from inside with four cam locks.

count-4.text: This step uses 1 top panel, 4 wood dowels and 4 cam locks.

step-5.text: Tap four dowels into the ends of the plinth board and press it in under the bottom panel, at the front.

count-5.text: This step uses 1 plinth and 4 wood dowels.

step-6.text: Roll the bookcase over so it lies on its front. Ask your helper, and put the flattened box underneath to save the finish.

count-6.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

step-7.text: Lay the back panel on, smooth side facing in. Line it up with the bottom corners and nail it along the edges, about every twenty centimeters. If the corners line up, the bookcase is square.

step-8.text: Second back piece, butted tight against the first. Same nailing pattern along every edge.

step-9.text: Stand it up together. Lift with your legs, not your back.

count-9.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

step-10.text: Push twelve shelf pins into the holes at the heights you like, four per shelf, then rest each shelf on top. Move them any time.

count-10.text: This step uses 3 shelves and 12 shelf pins.

step-11.text: Last step, and the most important. Screw the wall bracket to the top at the back, then fix it to the wall with screws that suit your wall. Furniture can tip over. Always anchor it.

done.text: Done. Your AMIRA open bookshelf is built. Give it a proud little pat.
